objects.name: Detection technique coverage: remote-process-instantiation-via-wmi-and-powershell-script-block
objects.description: The following analytic detects the execution of the `Invoke-WmiMethod` commandlet with parameters used to start a process on a remote endpoint via WMI, leveraging PowerShell Script Block Logging (EventCode=4104). This method identifies specific script block text patterns associated with remote process instantiation.
